1.description: Combat Experience is now a three-point talent.
Fixed an issue where Master Shapeshifter would stay on you after you unlearned the talent.
Fixed a bug where Abolish Curse effect could drop before duration ends.
Adrenaline Rush now has a 2 minute (down from 3) and is no longer on the global cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Chimera Shot was dealing Nature damage instead of Physical.
Improved Judgements is now a three point talent.
The buff granted by Swift Retribution now increases the casters' spell haste in addition to melee haste and now stacks to 3 times, from 2.
Sanctity of Battle no longer increases the amount of ticks of your Consecration, but instead makes your next Holy Fire deal 20% less damage but be a guaranteed critical strike.
The Balance Druid talent Vengeance now applies to all Balance spells.
Froststorm Breath from tamed Chimera pet now slows enemies by 40%, from 50%.
Increased the damage percentage of Mangle for ranks 3, 4 and 5 to match previous ranks.
Fixed an issue where Focused Burst would agro mobs at the start of cast instead of when the attacks hit the target.
Improved Hamstring now increases the damage of your Hamstring ability by 5/10/15%. The root effect has been moved to a Capstone.
Fixed an issue where Maelstrom Weapon would sometimes not work properly.
Fixed an issue where Kill Command would be consumed by non damaging special pet abilities.
Fixed an issue where Ghostlike Reflexes would not reduce the chance to be critically hit.
Fixed an issue where max rank of Improved Slam would not reduce the cast time of Slam as intended.
Fixed an issue where Black Arrow only increased damage of shots. It will now increase damage of all hunter abilities as intended.
Fixed missing name on Guru's Elixir Alchemy craft.

Fixed an issue where having Arcane Concentration and Brain Freeze buff active at the same time caused Fireball to consume both but still cost mana. As a result, only one of these buffs can be active at any given time.
Fixed an issue where Chaos Bolt could be reflected.
Fixed an issue where Hemorrhage would sometimes trigger its damage bonus on spell casts.
Fixed a tooltip issue with Mental Quickness showing as 0%.
Fixed a visual issue with Lone Wolf rank 1 showing the wrong tooltip.
[New Capstone]: Combat Experience - With the final rank of this talent, you gain 10% of your Agility as Spell Hit Rating.
[New Capstone]: Static Shock - With the final rank of this talent, your Stormstrike adds 3 charges to your Lightning Shield.
[New Capstone]: Focused Rage - With the final rank of this talent, you gain 5 rage every time the target of your Vigilance takes damage. This effect can only occur once every second.
[New Capstone]: Improved Judgements - With the final rank of this talent, Smite and Holy Fire can trigger your active seal for 15 seconds after using Judgement.
[New Capstone]: Swift Retribution - With the final rank of this talent, each stack of Swift Retribution also increases the damage of your Holy Fire and Smite by 5% of your attack power.
